subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose public cron restart catch-up controls, and should the supported API be the existing global max/stagger knobs, a skip/freshness policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but new cron config changes public compatibility and scheduled-message semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Expose narrow global controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

options.title: Design a skip policy
options.body: Use a global or per-job skip/freshness policy instead of exposing the raw internal knobs, preserving current catch-up defaults for existing users.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config and instead document current fixed restart catch-up behavior and safer cron authoring patterns.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow global controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit disable semantics for a zero immediate limit.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public config and scheduler-semantics decision, and steipete merged the original internal controls and has recent adjacent cron/config history.
